stories.headline: DOJ sends grand jury subpoenas to Philadelphia DA Krasner after judge's referral, sources say
stories.note: Progressive Philly DA Larry Krasner, a favorite of the soft-on-crime left, now faces a federal grand jury probe.

stories.headline: Ilhan Omar's sister questioned by feds after dramatic DC home raid
stories.note: The federal scrutiny around Rep. Ilhan Omar's circle keeps widening, now reaching her sister.

stories.headline: Manchin bucks Schumer, throws support behind Republican Democrats want to oust
stories.note: Former Democratic Sen. Joe Manchin crossing over to back a Republican is a blow to Schumer's Senate map.

stories.headline: Walz-era fraud scandal takes center stage as Klobuchar, GOP rival clash in debate: 'Why didn't you do more?'
stories.note: Minnesota's fraud scandal put Amy Klobuchar on defense in her debate with her Republican challenger.

stories.headline: Talarico skips Bernie Sanders rally in Texas, campaigns separately as Senate race heats up
stories.note: Texas Democrat James Talarico is keeping his distance from Bernie Sanders, a sign the far left is a liability in Texas.

stories.headline: Trump puts fraudsters on notice with $25M whistleblower program offering cash for tips that deliver
stories.note: Trump's new $25 million whistleblower program gives the GOP a fresh anti-fraud message heading into the midterms.
